title: Euromaidan
summary: Independence Square in Kyiv filled on 21 November 2013 after President Yanukovych refused, under Russian pressure, to sign the association agreement with the European Union that his own parliament had approved. The beating of students on 30 November turned a demonstration about a treaty into a movement about the government; the occupation lasted three months, more than a hundred protesters were shot in February 2014, and Yanukovych fled the country on the 22nd. Parliament removed him the same day. It was the largest mass movement in Europe since 1989, and Russia moved on Crimea within a week of its ending.
